text:
siva: FYI, nightly perf job flagged a KV cache hot-path regression after kernel-picker change.

siva: baseline vs current shows ~12% p99 increase on 2k tokens, nvprof trace attached.

marta: ugh, thanks. pinging @joel for kernel-selection changes yesterday :eyes:

joel: on it — I pushed the dynamic-kernel-score change, didn't expect this. Can you paste the perf link?

perf-bot: nightly-perf: https://artifacts.internal/redwood/2312345600/nvprof/kvcache-hotspot.nvprof :file_folder:

siva: tl;dr kernel A now gets chosen for cold KV hits; we previously preferred kernel B. timeline shows long memcpy in kernel A.

marta: can we reproduce locally w/ the same workload? I can run nsys on a small sample if you give the trace selection.

siva: sample command:
```
nsys profile --trace=nvtx,cuda --output=kvprobe --sample=100 -- python perf_probe.py --model small --seq 2048 --warmup 10 --iter 50
```

joel: hmm the selection heuristic score function was using throughput only. I'll update to consider memcpy cost + kernel-launch overhead.

devops-bot: nightlies/nvprof artifact uploaded to s3://redwood-ci/traces/2026-03-15/kvcache-hotspot.nvprof

marta: also seeing spike in host->dev memcpy, maybe batching heuristic increases stride causing more cache misses. @siva can you check batching logs?

siva: attaching batching snippet from CI:
```
batcher: max_batch_tokens=4096
batcher: prefer_latency=false
batcher: evict_kv_after=0.1
```

joel: I think prefer_latency=false allowed larger batches that hit a different kernel path. I'll try a quick revert of the score weighting in CI branch.

perf-bot: diff-dashboard: https://dash.internal/diffs/kvcache/2312345678 shows p99 regression isolated to kernel A, memcopy increased by 28%.

marta: plan: (1) reproduce locally w/ nsys, (2) add memcpy penalty to kernel selector, (3) run nightly smoke to confirm. Agree?

joel: +1. I'll open a PR and attach the perf traces.

siva: thanks. if fix looks good, can we add an autocollect rule to CI to capture both nvprof and perfetto when kernel selector changes? saves time next time.

devops-bot: suggestion recorded: tag=autocollect: triggers on label=kernel-selector modified in PR.

marta: great — one more ask: add a small smoke that runs on dedicated-gpu tier so we don't get noisy host interference.

joel: noted. I'll include a small nsys smoke in the PR pipeline with storage to artifacts.

siva: awesome, closing loop once PR lands. :thumbsup:
